missions.objective: Make the read-only Git porcelain v1 parser accept the documented T type-change flag in either status column. Count it as staged in the first column and unstaged in the second. Preserve rename, untracked, conflict and invalid-input handling and the exact function signature. No imports or changes outside the approved function.
missions.test:
import json, subprocess, sys
child = 'import json, runpy, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir="/scratch") as folder:
    source = Path(folder) / "src/agents/automation/diagnostic.py"
    source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    source.write_bytes(Path("/work/program.py").read_bytes())
    parse = runpy.run_path(str(source))["git_changes"]
    print(json.dumps([
        parse("R  new.txt\0old.txt\0?? untracked.txt\0UU conflict.txt\0"),
        parse("X  invalid.txt\0"),
        parse("T  staged.txt\0 T unstaged.txt\0TT both.txt\0"),
    ]))
'
run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', child], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=6)
assert run.returncode == 0  # case: child-exit | expected: The isolated child completes successfully.
try:
    data = json.loads(run.stdout)
except ValueError:
    raise AssertionError('child output is not JSON') from None  # case: child-json | expected: The isolated child emits one JSON value.
assert data[0] == {"staged": 1, "unstaged": 0, "untracked": 1, "conflicts": 1}  # case: existing-statuses | expected: Rename, untracked, and conflict counts are unchanged.
assert data[1] is None  # case: invalid-status | expected: An unknown Git status is refused.
assert data[2] == {"staged": 2, "unstaged": 2, "untracked": 0, "conflicts": 0}  # case: git-type-change | expected: T in each column counts as a staged or unstaged change.

missions.objective: Runtime metadata readers expect a JSON object. Return an empty dictionary when a readable JSON file's root is an array, null, string, number or boolean. Preserve existing behavior for valid objects, malformed JSON and missing files. Keep the exact function signature and add no imports.
missions.test:
import json, subprocess, sys
child = 'import json, runpy, tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\nload = runpy.run_path("/work/program.py")["load_json"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir="/scratch") as folder:\n    path = Path(folder) / "metadata.json"\n    results = [load(path)]\n    for text in (\'{"agent_definitions":[{"name":"fixture"}]}\', \'{\', \'[]\', \'null\', \'"name"\', \'1\', \'true\'):\n        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")\n        results.append(load(path))\nprint(json.dumps(results))\n'
run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', child], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=6)
assert run.returncode == 0  # case: child-exit | expected: The isolated child completes successfully.
try:
    data = json.loads(run.stdout)
except ValueError:
    raise AssertionError('child output is not JSON') from None  # case: child-json | expected: The isolated child emits one JSON value.
assert data[:3] == [{}, {"agent_definitions": [{"name": "fixture"}]}, {}]  # case: existing-metadata | expected: Missing and malformed metadata stays empty while valid objects survive.
assert data[3:] == [{}] * 5  # case: metadata-must-be-object | expected: A valid JSON value with a non-object root is treated as empty metadata.

missions.objective: Read task database lists written as UTF-8 with or without a BOM, as found in Windows exports. Keep list entries and Unicode values unchanged. Preserve the empty-list fallback for missing, malformed JSON or non-list input. Keep the exact function signature and add no imports.
missions.test:
import json, subprocess, sys
child = 'import json, runpy, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
rows = [{"id": "one", "title": "Café"}, {"id": "two", "title": "Réveil"}]
payload = json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False)
load = runpy.run_path("/work/program.py")["load_tasks"]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir="/scratch") as folder:
    path = Path(folder) / "tasks.json"
    results = [load(str(path))]
    for text, encoding in ((payload, "utf-8"), ("{", "utf-8"), ("{}", "utf-8"), (payload, "utf-8-sig")):
        path.write_text(text, encoding=encoding)
        results.append(load(str(path)))
print(json.dumps(results))
'
run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', child], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=6)
assert run.returncode == 0  # case: child-exit | expected: The isolated child completes successfully.
try:
    data = json.loads(run.stdout)
except ValueError:
    raise AssertionError('child output is not JSON') from None  # case: child-json | expected: The isolated child emits one JSON value.
rows = [{"id": "one", "title": "Café"}, {"id": "two", "title": "Réveil"}]
assert data[:4] == [[], rows, [], []]  # case: existing-task-db | expected: Plain UTF-8, missing, malformed, and non-list databases retain their behavior.
assert data[4] == rows  # case: windows-task-db-bom | expected: A UTF-8 BOM does not discard existing rows and Unicode titles.
